profile.headline: Building web3
profile.summary:
I'm a software builder; I’ve been doing this for nearly a decade now, in one way or another. My last role was 'principal engineer ' at a dev-tooling startup. I still maintain the open-source Python framework (Ape) and all its plugins.

For fun, I enjoy hiking, camping, and exploring with my husky, Neko. I make YouTube videos under the same name "antazoey" documenting these adventures.

tldr; I code outside!
